collector_v2.purpose: Future acquisition with corrected lexical repository parsing and distinct observed, unavailable and error states.

completed_work.interpretation: Idealized source-control scenarios and structural review coverage, not observed real-world hardening effects or attack probabilities.

completed_work.definition: Version-continuous reverse traversal begins at every retained root version and counts reached names; neither representation is an installation or a common-cutoff ecosystem graph.
completed_work.root_unit: original graph identifier, including bundled-context strings

completed_work.rule: Do not transfer a flag queried for a truncated repository to a corrected repository target; exclude or recollect.

completed_work.zero_interpretation: Directory absence and repository inaccessibility are conflated by the collector; zeros are not confirmed no-workflow observations.

completed_work.sampling_frame_defect: Eight selected bundled-context strings are invalid registry package sampling units; preserve frozen records and use a separately validated frame for a new package-level wave.
completed_work.sampling_unit: graph identifier; registry sampling frame not validated before frozen selection

completed_work.interpretation: Workflow-repository C/H/P for fixed identity selections are invariant to context removal; summed/maximum individual-package ranking invariance is not established. Context removal does not repair resolution context or make all-package counts a registry census.
Descriptive full-study resource measurements on one host with uncontrolled warm caches; not per-package latency, collection cost, deployed triage cost or development-assistance cost.

identifier_scope.interpretation: Identifier shape is not registry validation; the graph is not a census of independently registered npm packages.

literature_verification.scope: Targeted review, not a systematic review; maintainer unions and greedy coverage established by prior work.

pending_work.necessary_work: Freeze source versions, event role and withdrawal adjudication, reporting-delay allowance, censoring rules, analysis plan and power expectations. The 100-name sample is feasibility data, not a completed powered benchmark.
Observe and adjudicate future publicly documented publisher or release-pipeline compromises; retain no-report and unknown coverage distinctions.

Obtain pre-incident time-aligned dependency resolution, metadata and authority/workflow features plus a frozen at-risk population and documented-event ascertainment process. Certified-benign labels are not a prerequisite for a clearly specified documented-event/positive-unlabeled estimand.
Preserve resolution roots, lockfiles or resolver context and graph errors; version continuity alone does not establish joint installation feasibility.
Observe implemented security controls and their actual outcomes before claiming realized attack prevention or causal risk reduction.

primary_completed_question: How do dependency-version projection and workflow endpoint definitions change defensive review and idealized hardening measurements?

recent_git_review.interpretation: Reports retain the manuscript/archive version they inspected; current status is bound to current source and output manifests.
